title: Bad Guy theme. Great box!
text: This is my first Smugglers Bounty box and I definitely cannot complain. For $30 you get two pops, a t-shirt, a pin and a decal. The pops look really good. I am pleased with the Knight of Ren. The T-shirt also is pretty cool. I am personally glad that it wasn't a movie moment or something larger. I don't have room for those.
label: positive
